notes: Correct model logos for GLM, Gemini and proxy routes.
Add cache analytics, quota pacing, and expanded breakdown views.
Quota centre, quota alerts, project rollup, billing modes and FFF-speed scanning.
Fixed dragging the desktop window from the title bar.
Added settings to pin the title bar and remember window size and position.
Added a cache-clearing option that preserves sign-in data.
Added a startup recovery screen with a Retry button when the site cannot load.
Opening the app again now focuses the existing window.
Desktop updates now use menu controls for downloading and restarting, without interrupting playback with dialogs.
Reorder tabs by dragging or using Alt+Shift+Up/Down keyboard shortcuts.
Mute and unmute tabs directly from the speaker icon in the sidebar.
Inspect HTTPS security and clear cookies or site data from the address bar lock icon.
Remember site permission choices in your profile across visits.
Display site favicons in sidebar address bar suggestions.
Automatically dismiss empty tabs opened only for file downloads.
Regenerate high-resolution application and taskbar icons for Windows.
Restyled the floating subtitle pill in the dark theme with an electric cyan glow.
Added a double-tap hotkey lock so you can keep dictating without holding the key.
Added Escape to cancel a recording without transcribing or pasting it.
Added Ctrl+Alt+V to paste your last dictation again.
Added per-site app rules, so browser rules can match github.com, x.com and other sites instead of only the browser program.
